title: Quaint Buttery Brazilian Cheese Wrap
description: A buttery and flaky Brazilian dish featuring Vasterbottensost cheese, this quaint wrap is perfect for a snack or light meal, and is satvik-friendly as it contains no animal by-products except for the cheese.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a small bowl, mix together the melted butter, beaten egg, water, salt, and black pepper.
Brush the mixture onto the ssam wrap pieces, making sure to coat them evenly.
Place about 1 ounce of shredded Vasterbottensost cheese onto the center of each ssam wrap piece.
Fold the ssam wrap pieces in half to enclose the cheese, and brush the edges with a little bit of water to seal.
Place the wraps onto a baking sheet lined with parchment paper, and bake for 12 minutes, or until golden brown.
Remove the wraps from the oven, and sprinkle with chopped fresh parsley if desired.
Serve the quaint buttery Brazilian cheese wraps warm, and enjoy.
